items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Well, I played a lot of jobs off and on with Papa, you know, but I wasn't regular. I got in a band about five months before Papa died.

ctx.x: When did you first play with Papa?
Well, I played a lot of jobs off and on with Papa, you know, but I wasn't regular. I got in a band about five months before Papa died. I was appointed, you know.
I think that about covers most of everything. We only got about two seconds left on here. Okay. Let that run once here.
